boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain East Carolina University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and snack stops with directly verified evening, midnight, or overnight availability on campus and around Greenville.

cards.title: Subs Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A West Campus counter at Reade Circle
cards.notes: Head to Reade Circle before midnight for a made-to-order sandwich; confirm day-specific service before leaving your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus sandwich counter with midnight closing seven days a week under standard hours.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU's dining page lists Subway Reade Street at 100 Reade Circle and gives standard hours of 11 a.m.–midnight Monday–Friday and noon–midnight Saturday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Subway Reade Street - East Carolina University
cards.access_notes: Standard hours currently run until 12:00 a.m. every day; campus schedules may change during breaks or special periods.

cards.title: The Midnight Market Stop
cards.subtitle: Convenience food beside West End Dining Hall
cards.notes: Use this stop for packaged snacks, drinks, frozen food or a microwaveable meal when you need flexible choices close to West Campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience market explicitly presented by ECU Dining as an open-late option.
cards.evidence_claim: ECU's dining page identifies Pirate Market beside West End Dining Hall, describes it as open late, and lists standard hours ending at midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Pirate Market Reade Street - East Carolina University
cards.access_notes: Standard hours are 11:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m. weekdays and 12:00 p.m.–12:00 a.m. weekends; check break schedules.

cards.title: Cookies After Evening Classes
cards.subtitle: A dessert storefront on East Fifth Street
cards.notes: Walk to the Fifth Street bakery for cookies or ice cream, but check the live store page before relying on its latest pickup or delivery cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown bakery whose official storefront advertises cookie delivery into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies' official Greenville store page advertises warm-cookie delivery until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Warm Cookies Delivered Until 3 AM Daily | Insomnia Cookies
cards.access_notes: The official store page advertises delivery until 3:00 a.m. daily; verify the live pickup and delivery windows before ordering.

cards.title: A Weekend 3 A.M. Burger Run
cards.subtitle: Late counter service on East 10th Street
cards.notes: Save this East 10th Street option for a late Friday or Saturday meal; use the posted address and confirm hours before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A University District burger counter with substantially later weekend closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant's official Greenville page lists 2907 E 10th Street and hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours end at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; call ahead if traveling late.

cards.title: The 3 A.M. Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A late vehicle-service option beside campus
cards.notes: Use mobile ordering or the drive-through after the lobby closes, and arrange a safe ride because the late window is not walk-in service.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge McDonald's whose official listing separates late drive-through service from earlier lobby access.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official location page lists the restaurant at 310 E 10th Street and drive-through hours from 4:30 a.m. until 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Greenville, NC at 310 E 10th St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed until 3:00 a.m. daily, while restaurant and lobby hours end at 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Doughnuts at Eleven
cards.subtitle: A bright East Tenth Street bakery stop
cards.notes: Make this an earlier late-night run on Friday or Saturday, when both the shop and drive-through remain open an hour later than weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable doughnut shop with official late-evening weekend hours near ECU.
cards.evidence_claim: Krispy Kreme's official Greenville page lists 300 E Tenth Street and shop and drive-through hours until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fresh Doughnuts and Coffee | Krispy Kreme Greenville - NC
cards.access_notes: Shop and drive-through close at 11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: A Late Dinner in a Retro Booth
cards.subtitle: Sit-down dining on Dickinson Avenue
cards.notes: Plan this as a full dinner rather than a post-midnight run; arrive with enough time for table service before the posted closing hour.
cards.short_summary: A named retro-style diner in the Dickinson Avenue district with dinner service through 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Native Fine Diner's official site places it at 907 Dickinson Avenue, a few blocks from ECU, and lists dinner from 5:30–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Native Fine Diner | Restaurant in Greenville NC
cards.access_notes: Dinner is posted from 5:30 p.m. to 10:00 p.m. Monday–Saturday; the restaurant is closed Sunday.

cards.title: Breakfast at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: An all-night diner on Greenville Boulevard
cards.notes: Choose this staffed diner when the campus-edge counters have closed, and arrange transportation to Greenville Boulevard rather than walking late.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner southeast of campus with the same posted availability every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official page identifies unit #187 at 306 Greenville Boulevard SE and lists it as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 24-hour operation Monday–Sunday; verify conditions before making an overnight trip.

cards.title: The 10 P.M. Cookie Window
cards.subtitle: Dessert pickup at University Commons
cards.notes: Treat this as an early late-night dessert stop and review the current weekly menu before traveling to the South Evans Street storefront.
cards.short_summary: A University Commons bakery with consistently posted 10 p.m. closing times six days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: Crumbl's official University Commons page lists the Greenville shop at 3040 S Evans Street and hours until 10 p.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Cookies and Desserts in Greenville | Crumbl
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 8:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday–Saturday and does not list Sunday service.

cards.title: The Memorial Drive All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: A second 24-hour diner across Greenville
cards.notes: Keep this Memorial Drive location as a transportation-dependent overnight fallback, and verify operations before making the longer trip from campus.
cards.short_summary: A distinct west-side Greenville diner with official round-the-clock service.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House's official page identifies unit #995 at 820 S Memorial Drive and lists it as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 24-hour operation Monday–Sunday; confirm service before an overnight drive.
